verdict.rationale: Evidence only confirms a native mobile app exists and supports reviewing code diffs, commenting, and interacting with Linear Agent (linear-docs-6), plus mobile-persistent pinned tabs (linear-docs-20/39), but there is no documentation of full task-management parity (issue triage, project views, initiatives, docs) on mobile matching desktop. missing for 10: evidence of full issue/project management parity on mobile, explicit no-desktop-feature-gap claims, independent reviews confirming mobile completeness.
